chunks: Allah is sufficient as a Reckoner.
Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, said: 'Indeed, Allah will make the people account for what they do.'
And He said: 'And your Lord is not unjust to the servants.'

key_terms.وَكَيْلًا: A Reckoner / One who measures precisely
key_terms.يُحَاسِبُ: He makes account / He holds to account

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Allah's justice in holding people accountable?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes these verses to reinforce the doctrine of *Hisab* (accountability), a cornerstone of Shia theology that underscores Allah’s absolute justice (*Adl*) and sufficiency as the ultimate Judge. This narration serves to comfort the believers by affirming that divine reckoning is precise and free from any injustice, thereby validating the moral responsibility of individuals in light of the Imamate's guidance.
